question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The little girl tried to _________ the singer.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****imitate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Imitate: **to copy the behaviour of somebody/something.

 
 
• **Example: **My younger sister always tries to** imitate** me.
 
 
 
• In the given context, the little girl tried to sing like the singer. She tried to copy the way the singer sang. 
 
• ​Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *The little girl tried to **__imitate__ **the singer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Imply: **to suggest something in an indirect way or without actually saying it.
 
• **Languish: **to lose strength or energy and not make any progress in something.
 
• **Emit: **to send out something, for example, a smell, a sound, smoke, heat, or light.
